Surjectivity of the particle-motion sum onto H1(K5;Q) forces the independent rational upper bound rank(d2)<=1100, completing the rational Betti computation (1,6,30,0). The signed Lefschetz traces of seven classes, equivariant identification of H1 with graph cycles and character inner products force the stated S5 decomposition. The standalone supplied verifier reconstructs and checks the necessary finite calculations.

originality.rationale: The natural complete-graph S5-character is not supplied by the examined stronger or equivalent published results. The nearest same-particle K4 and general wheel-graph classifications do not cover K5, and general graph-braid first-homology formulas cannot determine a second-degree S5-module. Exact comparison with the deduplicated indexed records identified other graphs and numbers of particles. Residual risk of alternative unindexed representation computations is explicitly acknowledged.
residual_risks: An indexed or unindexed graph-braid homology paper might contain an equivalent K5 S5 representation under alternative language.
The original Abrams thesis was accessed through a dated institutional record, not fully inspected; its general discretization theorem is not treated as a novelty exclusion.
Absence of a database match is not proof of global originality; independent human bibliographic review remains outstanding.

value.rationale: The smallest nonplanar complete graph has the full canonical S5 vertex action on three-particle motion topology. A complete top-homology character with traces only on identity and double transpositions, five nontrivial Specht types, one repeated six-dimensional type, and no invariant class is a motivated equivariant classification, beyond nonequivariant rank and prior H1 results. The limited three-particle rational scope is appropriate to its geometric motivation; no downstream theorem is claimed.
